description: Generate an llms.txt file body for a public website from its fetched metadata: site name, description and key pages. Returns the text to serve at the site root as /llms.txt; an agent in the site's repo should write it to public/llms.txt (Next.js) or the web root, reviewing the Key Pages list first. STATE THIS WHEN OFFERING IT: there is no evidence any answer engine reads llms.txt. Google said in July 2025 that it does not support the file and is not planning to; Ahrefs found 97% of published llms.txt files received zero crawler requests across 137,210 domains (May 2026); no major lab has committed to reading it in production. It is harmless to serve and some smaller tools do read it, but it is not a visibility fix, it is not scored by get_visibility_score, and promising a citation lift from it would be false. Use when the user asks for the file knowing that.

url.description: A domain (example.com) or full URL to generate llms.txt for.

name: generate_llms_txt
